captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a flat, thin, kickboard-like object. It features a rectangular body with a fully rounded, semi-circular profile on one end, while the opposite end has slightly rounded corners. The overall thickness is uniform, creating a smooth, flat plate with curved boundaries.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric kickboard plate in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the length, width, and thickness of the board. The model should feature a large semi-circular curve on one end and smaller rounded corners on the other end to form a smooth, safe edge.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of cylinders and scaled cubes inside a difference block. A large cylinder with a scaled radius of `width * 5` (scaled down by 0.1) forms the main rounded end. A translated and scaled cube forms the rectangular body. The two smaller corners on the opposite end are rounded by placing two smaller cylinders of radius 12.5 (scaled down by 0.1) at the outer edges, connected by a small bridging cube.
